title: Chapter 82
text:
The Germinal Organization's fleet quickly turned around and fled.

Carl's eyes flashed, and he ordered, "Cover them with fire, blow them all up!"

The adjutant understood what Carl meant. He was secretly shocked, but he quickly passed down the order and set the attack range.

The fleet, equipped with honeycomb missile launchers, slowly moved forward and fired a barrage of short-range rockets.

Big Black happened to be at the edge of the bombardment range!

The sharp-eyed members of Division 13 noticed this, and they were both shocked and furious.

The adjutant quickly explained, "We miscalculated the range. This is bad."

Qi Bai Jia was enraged. "Carl, what are you trying to do?!" he yelled. "What are you trying to do?!"

Carl did not answer. He was expressionless, but there was a flash of coldness in his eyes.

If you want to blame someone, blame yourself for not being from Hesla.

The flames of the rockets left a bright and murderous glow on Li Ya Lin's retina. She said in horror, "Are they trying to blow us all up?"

"Hesla did it on purpose!" Zhang Wei was furious.

Although he knew that participating in the joint operation would not avoid the hostility of the other countries, he did not expect this commander to actually take action. If they died, it would be a waste of their lives. He could just say that it was an accident and get away with it.

Only the radicals would use such a dirty trick to kill their allies without thinking of the consequences!

The Germinal Organization was the common enemy of the Six Nations. Everyone agreed to fight against terrorism, but they were not allies. There was constant friction. The leaders pretended to be polite, and the people below them were the pawns of the war. (Familiar, right?)

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and shouted, "Nitrogen acceleration!"

Li Ya Lin immediately pressed the button. The exhaust pipe of the heavy truck burst into blue flames, and the truck's speed suddenly increased like a raging rhinoceros. The sudden acceleration force pinned her to the seat, and she could not move.

The rocket launcher array was rapidly approaching. Three hundred meters, two hundred meters, one hundred meters, fifty meters!

"Boom!"

Finally, the hot wind blew up a mushroom-like dust cloud, and a continuous cloud of fire rose from the plains. In an instant, everyone was temporarily deafened. The sound was beyond the human ear's tolerance. The explosion scene in front of them seemed to have turned into a pantomime. All that was left was the dazzling flames that kept expanding and rising, illuminating the entire night sky!

Everything within the attack range, be it cars or people, was torn into pieces!

After a full three seconds, the buzzing sound entered his ears again!

The agents of Division 13 were enraged.

Di Su Su's eyes were filled with grief and murderous intent. Green flames were faintly rising from her body.

"Hu —"

The wind blew.

The heavy truck broke through the black fog, dragging the burning rear of the truck as it staggered out. A small part of the cargo compartment was blown up, and some equipment and parts were turned into scrap iron.

"They're still alive!"

The members of Division 13 were pleasantly surprised.

Li Ya Lin still had a lingering fear in her heart. It was only ten meters away, and Big Black almost couldn't escape the range of the firepower. If it wasn't for the nitrogen acceleration, there would be nothing left of it this time!

Han Xiao suddenly coughed up a mouthful of bloody phlegm. He wasn't completely unscathed. The shockwave of the explosion had entered his body, causing him to lose over 200 HP. His back had slammed into the carriage, and the second shockwave had caused him to lose another 50 HP. Even now, he was still feeling dizzy.

After the nitrogen-fueled acceleration was completed, the engine of the heavy truck was overloaded. It only stopped when it reached the front of Hesla's army.

When the Hesla soldiers saw the countless bullet holes on the heavy truck at close range, they felt a chill down their spines.

What kind of intense battle had this truck been through? It was as if they had been shot into a sieve.

"It's a pity that the explosion didn't kill them." Carl frowned slightly in disappointment.

Han Xiao and the rest alighted from the truck, and the agents of Division 13 quickly surrounded them. Qi Bai Jia was so scared that he broke out in cold sweat. When he saw that Han Xiao was fine, he heaved a sigh of relief.

At this time, Carl walked over, and the agents of Division 13 immediately glared at him. Zhang Wei gritted his teeth and controlled the armored vehicle to approach Carl. The soldiers at the side immediately pointed their guns at them. The adjutant shouted, "What are you doing? Step back!"

"I want an explanation!" Zhang Wei shouted.

Explanation? Childish.

Carl ignored him. He glanced at Han Xiao and said calmly, "Where are the captives that you mentioned?"

"… dead."

Carl had sent the troops ahead of time and put him in danger. The two captives that he had painstakingly captured had died because of this. Most importantly, Carl had wanted to kill him with the explosion.

Han Xiao lowered his eyes to hide the coldness in his eyes.

"So, you don't have any evidence?" Carl frowned with dissatisfaction. His attitude once again angered the agents of Division 13. However, logic told them not to act rashly. They were in Hesla's territory, and if they were to turn hostile, they would definitely die.

Qi Bai Jia suppressed his anger and said coldly, "Just wait for Division 13 to question you!"

Carl did not care. Division 13 could not do anything to him. This was just a "mistake" without evidence. At most, he would be criticized by Division 13. It was not a big deal.

As long as he could conquer the Dark Crow Valley, he would be able to earn a considerable amount of merit. With the help of the people behind him, he would be able to become one of the core forces of the radical faction. No matter how Division 13 criticized him, he would be rejected by the higher-ups of Hesla.

Carl thought for a while and pointed at Han Xiao, who seemed to be the most seriously injured, and said, "Bring him to the medics to check on his injuries."

Han Xiao was expressionless as he followed the medics to the logistics vehicle. His injuries were all soft tissue injuries. With his endurance, he would recover after a short rest. He waved the medics away.

The logistics vehicle started moving quickly, and the Hesla army continued to advance.

He shook his head, lay on the bed, and closed his eyes to rest.

He had not slept since yesterday. Now was a good time to rest.

…

The sound of gunshots could be heard from afar. Han Xiao opened his eyes. He had been a light sleeper. When he got out of the vehicle, he realized that it was around three or four in the morning.

At this time, the Hesla army had already reached the Dark Crow Valley security zone. The front line was engaged in a fierce battle. The six-layer security zone of the Dark Crow Valley base was not only for patrols and sentry posts. It was also a buffer zone for large scale armies. There were many bunkers and watchtowers. At this time, these strategic points were all guarded by enemies. It was a wartime situation. If the Hesla army wanted to get close to the Dark Crow Valley base, they would first have to break through the six-layer security zone.

In the forest, the Hesla army attacked all kinds of fortifications, watchtowers, and bunkers. Based on Ye Fan's intelligence, they were gradually advancing.

Han Xiao was in the logistics unit, far away from the battlefield.

Two soldiers were waiting by the side. Han Xiao asked casually.

"How is the situation now?"

One of the soldiers said, "It is going well. Our army has advanced to the fourth layer of the outer perimeter."

Han Xiao nodded. Just as he was about to leave, two soldiers stopped him.

"The colonel wants you to recuperate here."

When Han Xiao heard this, he immediately understood that Carl had put him under house arrest. He frowned and asked, "What about my companions?"

"Your commanding officer also ordered us to look after you and let you rest."

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He understood Qi Bai Jia's intention. He did not want him to take any more risks. Qi Bai Jia did not dare to let Han Xiao go to the front line personally after he was almost killed by the rocket launchers.

"This is actually more beneficial to my plan."

Han Xiao thought to himself.

He turned around and saw that Dahei was being dragged by a tow truck. It was parked at the side. The chase had almost destroyed the truck. It would not be usable without a major repair.

Han Xiao's eyes lit up. He walked toward the truck.

The two soldiers did not stop him. As long as Han Xiao did not leave the logistics area, they would not interfere.

He walked into the cargo compartment. Everything was still there. The bodies of the two captives had been disposed of. Han Xiao took out a communication device from the box and connected it to Lin Yao's frequency.

"Lin Yao, are you still alive?"

"Damn, I'm still alive." Lin Yao's annoyed voice came through the earpiece.

"What's the situation now?"

"We are preparing to evacuate. I heard from the higher-ups that the other bases have deployed all their forces to stop Hesla's army. However, we have not found out the evacuation route yet. It seems that we will only know when we evacuate together. Oh right, I found out that the information given by Ye Fan was fake. The distribution of fortifications from the third to the sixth level was real, but the first and second levels were completely different. If Hesla's army had followed Ye Fan's information, they would have suffered heavy losses."

"Did you tell them?"

"No, you are the first person to contact me."

"That's good. Don't inform Hesla."

Lin Yao was puzzled. "Why?"

Han Xiao told Lin Yao about the rocket launcher incident. Lin Yao was furious. "This is too much!"

Carl had exposed his killing intent. Naturally, Division 13 would not help their army to reduce their losses.

Han Xiao provided the information for the sake of completing the mission. Only by killing Pan Kuang, Ji Ji, and the other core members would the mission completion rate be high. Carl saw him as a tool, and so did Han Xiao. They used each other's information, and he used his army. It was a mutual benefit.

As long as Hesla's army could complete the mission according to his information, he did not care how many people died in Hesla.

However, Carl's sudden killing intent was unexpected.

"It's time to change the plan."
